notice.title: Bricking issue fixed for Rockbox-Y1.
notice.content: Rockbox-Y1 0.5 is now compatible with Y1s sold after April 2026.
notice.full_content:
**Type B hardware** (Y1 players shipped after April 2026, with pre-installed software 3.0.7 or newer) is now supported by Rockbox-Y1 0.5 and newer builds.
- Updater CE filters incompatible older packages automatically. - The Firmware Archive asks for the device type before listing Y1 packages, so you can pick Type A or Type B directly.
More detail is in the [Rockbox Y1 notes](https://innioasis.app/rockbox-y1-software.html).

notice.title: About Notices in Updater CE
notice.content: You'll get important alerts about device safety issues reported by the community here, such as when devices are being bricked by certain firmware.
notice.full_content:
The Notices feed delivers community-verified hardware advisories, firmware compatibility warnings for Type A and Type B players, and new software announcements across Updater CE, Firmware Archive, and Themes Gallery.
1. **Safety first** - bricking reports and hardware revisions appear here before anything else. 2. **No account needed** - every notice has a permanent page you can link to. 3. **Read in full** - open a notice to see the whole write-up, not just the headline.

notice.title: Rockbox Y1 Compatibility Warning
notice.content: This Rockbox-Y1 release predates 0.5 and is not compatible with Y1 units shipped with firmware 3.0.7 or later. Flashing will prevent booting.
notice.full_content: This Rockbox-Y1 release predates version 0.5. It is not compatible with Innioasis Y1 hardware shipped after March 2026 with Innioasis OS 3.0.7 pre-installed. Flashing this legacy build on those devices will prevent booting until restored via [Updater CE's SP Flash Tool engine](https://innioasis.app/Troubleshooting/recover-non-booting-device.html#sp-flash-tool-engine).

notice.title: Original Software Y1 Compatibility Warning
notice.content: This Original Software release predates 3.0.7 and will prevent booting on newer Y1 hardware until a compatible build is installed.
notice.full_content: This Original Software release predates 3.0.7. It is not compatible with Y1 units manufactured with Innioasis OS 3.0.7 or later. Flashing it will leave the device in a non-booting state until 3.0.7 or higher is installed using [Updater CE's SP Flash Tool engine](https://innioasis.app/Troubleshooting/recover-non-booting-device.html#sp-flash-tool-engine).
